title: Low-Slope Roof Replacement in Fairview, OR
summary: In July 2026, French Roofing put a new low-slope roof on a home in Fairview, OR, finished where the roof meets the wall and around every pipe that comes through it.
scope: Finished where the roof meets the wall
Finished around every pipe that comes through the roof, with metal flashing bases
